intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Chennai region. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF 2025 Engineering ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

Chennai Institute of Technology vs SRM Institute of Science and Technology is a smaller Chennai engineering college compared with a large deemed university. SRM holds the much higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 14, against CIT at 101.

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology vs SRM Institute of Science and Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SRM if NIRF 2025 Engineering rank and a large deemed-university campus matter most. SRM is ranked 14 in that list. CIT is ranked 101.
Choose CIT if you want the more recent placement record on this page. CIT has 2023 figures here, while SRM's latest recorded placement year on this page is 2016, which we do not treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹50,000 for CIT B.Tech programmes. That figure looks low for a private Chennai college and may be a category or quota fee, so confirm CIT's official fee notice before you budget.
SRM's recorded tuition on this page is ₹2.50 lakh a year. A registration fee of ₹10,000 also appears in the raw rows; that is not the flagship tuition and should not be read as the programme fee.
On recorded year tuition, SRM is substantially higher than the CIT figure we hold. Use official circulars, not the lowest raw row, when you compare costs.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CIT's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹22 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

SRM's latest recorded placement year here is 2016, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹42 lakh. Because that year is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.
Ask SRM for its latest official placement report. Do not compare a 2016 SRM row with CIT's 2023 figures as if they described the same year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: CIT lists JEE Main and TNEA on this page. Most Anna University-affiliated seats in Tamil Nadu go through TNEA counselling.
SRM lists SRMJEEE, its own entrance test. Check SRM's current admissions page for any JEE Main or direct pathways that may also apply.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in the Chennai region of Tamil Nadu. SRM's main Kattankulathur campus is a large suburban university. CIT is a separate Chennai engineering campus.
Visit both if commute and hostel life will decide the choice. The city name is shared; the campus scale is not.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the much higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank and a large deemed university, SRM is the stronger name on paper, at rank 14.
If you want a 2023 placement record on this page and a lower recorded year fee, CIT is the side with current figures here, but you must confirm whether ₹50,000 is really the fee for your quota.
Do not use SRM's ₹10,000 registration row or its 2016 placement row as the comparison headline.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Chennai Institute of Technology or SRM, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: SRM has the much higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 14 against CIT's 101. CIT has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2023. SRM's latest recorded placement year here is 2016.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for CIT vs SRM?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹50,000 a year for CIT, which may be a quota or category fee and should be checked on CIT's official notice. SRM's recorded tuition is ₹2.50 lakh a year. A ₹10,000 SRM registration fee in the raw rows is not the programme tuition.

faqs.question: Which exams do CIT and SRM accept?
faqs.answer: CIT lists JEE Main and TNEA. SRM lists SRMJEEE. Confirm the current official admissions page of each institute for any additional routes.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CIT and SRM?
faqs.answer: CIT's recorded 2023 average is ₹6 lakh and the highest is ₹22 lakh. SRM's latest recorded year here is 2016, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result. Ask SRM for its latest official report.

faqs.question: Are CIT and SRM both in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Both are in the Chennai region of Tamil Nadu, on different campuses. SRM's main campus is at Kattankulathur. Visit both if the exact location matters.
